description: Schema for each batch JSON file produced by sub-agents. Each file contains an array of defect RCA results.

severity.description: Severity value (e.g., S1 - Urgent, S2 - High)

environment_leaked.description: Environment where defect leaked: Production, UAT, or EA

relationship.description: Link relationship (e.g., is child of, relates to)

linked_jira_tickets.description: Linked Jira issues from issuelinks field

linked_ticket_description.description: 3-line summary of linked Jira tickets: What was the issue? What was changed? Why?

pr_summaries.description: 2-line summary for each PR: what changed & why. Parallel array to linked_prs.

defect_description.description: 3-line summary from Jira description/comments: What was the issue? What was changed? Why?

pr_description.description: 3-line summary from PR descriptions: What was the issue? What was changed? Why?

code_description.description: 3-line summary from code diffs: What was the issue? What was changed? Why?

why_qa_missed.description: One-word reason why QA missed this defect

qa_recommendation.description: One-line actionable recommendation for QA to avoid missing this kind of defect

why_dev_missed.description: One-word reason why dev missed this in development lifecycle

dev_recommendation.description: One-line actionable recommendation for dev to avoid this kind of defect
